name: claude-code-notify
description: Plays a distinct sound when Claude Code needs your attention or finishes a task.

Claude Code Notify: Mark All as Read
Claude Code Notify: Test 'Needs Attention' Event
Claude Code Notify: Send Test Phone Push

claudeCodeNotify.attentionSound.description: Sound file played when Claude Code needs your approval/attention.

claudeCodeNotify.completeSound.description: Sound file played when Claude Code finishes responding.

claudeCodeNotify.showStatusBar.description: Show the Claude item in the status bar: orange with counts while sessions need you, blue when only completions are unread. Click for the list.

claudeCodeNotify.showToast.description: Also show a VS Code toast (with an Open button) for each event.

claudeCodeNotify.focusTerminalOnWindowFo.description: When you switch to a VS Code window where a Claude Code session is waiting for approval, automatically reveal that terminal.

claudeCodeNotify.dismissOnView.description: Heuristic: mark a notification read when you switch to its terminal or focus its window. Off by default — notifications then clear only when you reply/approve or dismiss them explicitly (list click, ✕, Mark all as read, Jump).

claudeCodeNotify.autoReadDelay.description: Optional: if a notification arrives while its terminal is already in front in the focused window, mark it read after this many seconds. 0 (default) = off; notifications clear only when you reply/approve, switch to that terminal, or dismiss them.

claudeCodeNotify.nagIntervalMinutes.description: Repeat the 'needs attention' sound every N minutes while any session is still waiting for approval. 0 = off.

claudeCodeNotify.ntfyTopic.description: ntfy.sh topic to push phone notifications to. Subscribe to this exact topic in the free ntfy app. Treat it like a password — anyone who knows it can read your pushes. Empty = phone push off.

claudeCodeNotify.ntfyServer.description: ntfy server base URL. Change only if you self-host ntfy.

claudeCodeNotify.ntfyPush.description: When to push to your phone: 'off', 'attention' (approvals only), or 'all' (approvals + completions).
